# AGENTS.md

## How to invoke agents

### Claude Code
Claude Code reads `CLAUDE.md` automatically at session start. The `## Agent Context` section summarises the roster and handoffs. The agents themselves live in `.claude/agents/` and can be invoked by name (for example, "use the core agent to …") or picked automatically from their descriptions.

### Codex
Codex reads this file natively — there is no roster file to register and no activation prefix.
Starting at the Git root it walks down to your working directory, taking at most one instruction
file per directory (`AGENTS.override.md` takes precedence over `AGENTS.md`) and concatenating
them root-first, so a deeper file overrides a shallower one. The combined size is capped by
`project_doc_max_bytes` (32 KiB by default).

---

## Repo

EditPad is a lightweight plain-text editor for iPhone and iPad that opens any text file from the Files app and saves it back with its original encoding, byte order mark and line endings.

## Stack

- Swift / SwiftUI, iOS and iPadOS 17+, Xcode 16 (folder-synchronized project, objectVersion 77)
- App target `EditPad` (Swift 5 language mode) built on `DocumentGroup` + `FileDocument`
- Local Swift package `EditPadKit` (Foundation only, swift-tools-version 5.9) for all file-format logic
- XCTest; CI on GitHub Actions: package tests on Linux (swift:6.0) and macOS 15, plus an iOS Simulator build
- No third-party dependencies

## How we work

- Changes land on `main`; every push and pull request runs `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.
- A change is done when `swift test --package-path Packages/EditPadKit` passes and the CI iOS Simulator build succeeds.
- No device signing or App Store deployment is automated; distribution is a manual, human step.
- Architecture decisions are recorded in `DECISIONS.md`.

## Off-limits

- `PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER`, code-signing settings and `DEVELOPMENT_TEAM` in `EditPad.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj`: human only.
- `LICENSE`: never edit.
- Round-trip tests in `Packages/EditPadKit/Tests/`: may be extended, never weakened or deleted.
- Force-pushing or rewriting history on `main`: never.
- App Store Connect, TestFlight and release tagging: human only.

## Agent roster

| Agent | Owns | Hands off to |
|-------|------|--------------|
| coordinator | routing, planning, AGENTS.md | everyone |
| core | Packages/EditPadKit/Sources/ | app (UI exposure), test-writer (coverage) |
| app | EditPad/, Config/, EditPad.xcodeproj/ | core (file-format logic) |
| test-writer | Packages/EditPadKit/Tests/ | core (bugs found) |
| navigator | read-only Q&A | the owning task agent |

## Conventions

- Text in memory is always `\n`-normalized; only `EditPadKit` converts line endings.
- Every encoding or line-ending path needs a byte-for-byte round-trip test.
- Preference keys and defaults live in `EditPad/EditorSettings.swift`.
- New app source files go in `EditPad/` and are picked up automatically; don't hand-edit file references in the project file.
- Commit messages: imperative subject under 72 characters, blank line, body explaining why.
